Desktop and two landscape sizes check equal counter widths, amounts/icons, exact accessible balances, timer and dropdown reachability, asset loading and existing navigation. The shortest landscape layout puts simultaneous incoming/outgoing alerts in one row to clear the taller stack. Existing timer expiration, scrolling and location actions remain covered.

Add those existing controls to its collision avoidance list. Run production packaging/reference/budget validation and existing installation-cache budgets. No existing offline, entry, runtime performance or total artifact limit is relaxed.

Record the owner's confirmed artwork, counter order and timer alignment alongside source provenance, final generation prompts, delivery encodings and validation instructions. Documentation makes no production deployment claim.
